issues.description: The problem statement requires the Animal name getter and setter to have protected visibility, but the solution implements them as public. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected access level and may cause tests or grading scripts that check visibility to fail or be inconsistent with the reference implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility of Animal.getName() and Animal.setName(String) protected to match the problem statement and UML. Alternatively, update the problem statement and UML to specify public visibility if public methods were intended; ensure tests and solution are updated accordingly.
